why: A delivers the requested warm Nordic look with light ash woods, cream textiles, green accents and a bamboo pendant, all forming one cohesive scheme. Its only real weaknesses are a small 70 cm coffee table and a 140 cm table that is tight for six. B's 180 cm table suits six better, but its walnut coffee table, ornate grey rug, black chairs, industrial pendant and black boho throw pull away from the light-wood, cream brief.
